description: This Java source file defines the DittoMongoClientSettings class, which encapsulates additional configuration settings for a MongoDB client, such as maximum query time, within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a nested Builder class for constructing instances with fluent API.

classes.name: DittoMongoClientSettings
classes.description: Immutable class representing custom settings for Ditto MongoDB client, primarily the maximum query time.

classes.name: DittoMongoClientSettings.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class to construct DittoMongoClientSettings instances with optional custom max query time.

methods.description: Static method returning a new Builder instance for constructing DittoMongoClientSettings.

methods.description: Getter method returning the max query time setting.

methods.description: Fluent setter method for specifying the maximum query duration via long and TemporalUnit.

methods.name: maxQueryTime
methods.description: Setter method allowing to set the max query time directly with a Duration or revert to default if null.

methods.description: Constructs and returns the immutable DittoMongoClientSettings instance based on the builder's parameters.
